cadastreAuthority: SII (fiscal cadastre, no open vector service); CIREN / MINAGRI IDE publishes the rural property graphic cadastre (SII-derived) as an open ArcGIS service

portalsFound.observation: IDE Chile national catalogue (pycsw 2.6.1 CSW, open). AnyText 'predial' finds 'Catastro Gráfico de la Propiedad Rural 1:10.000/1:20.000' records for ~14 regions (source homer.sii.cl / CIREN) plus 'Servicio Web de Mapas - Propiedades Rurales' pointing to the esri.ciren.cl WMS. No urban predio service is catalogued.

ArcGIS Server 11.5, Query enabled, 14 polygon layers one per region (Arica y Parinacota ... Aysén, vintages 2004-2023). Fields: rol, codicomu, desccomu, comudere, provdere, regidere (no owner fields).

All open MINVU folders listed (Art55, Catastros, Hosted, IPT, Otros, Planes_Programas ...); only Hosted/PREDIOS_VALPARAISO is a predio layer; Catastros/GESTION_SUELO layers are state land, not parcels; several folders need a token (499).
SII Mapas viewer (previous pass): server-side facade and WMS proxy only; urban fiscal parcels not exposed as vector.

remainingUncertainty: Licence of the CIREN service not read. Layers are per-region with different vintages (Aysen 2004). Urban parcels nationally still only via SII viewer. Layer 9 (Biobio) lacks the codicomu field.
nextStep: Read CIREN/IDE MINAGRI licence; enumerate other layers per region; for urban, combine MINVU PREDIOS_VALPARAISO and investigate SII open-data (tabular roles).
